units.source_text: 白98，名人又沉思了半个多小时。

en.t: After White 98, the Master sank into thought again for more than half an hour.

units.source_text: 他微张开嘴，眨巴着眼睛，扇着扇子，好像要把灵魂深处的火焰扇旺似的。

en.t: His mouth was slightly open, his eyes blinked, and he kept fanning himself, as if trying to fan the flames deep in his soul into greater force.

units.source_text: 难道要这样对弈下去吗？

en.t: Were they really going to keep playing like this?
